hooks.command: { f=$(jq -r "(.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path) // empty"); [ -n "$f" ] && [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; R="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; case "$f" in "$R"/*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in *node_modules/*) exit 0;; esac; B="$R/node_modules/.bin"; case "$f" in *.js|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.ts|*.tsx|*.astro) "$B/eslint" --fix --no-warn-ignored "$f";; esac; case "$f" in *.css|*.scss|*.astro) "$B/stylelint" --fix --allow-empty-input "$f";; esac; "$B/prettier" --write --ignore-unknown --log-level warn "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.statusMessage: lint --fix と Prettier で整形中...
